minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  May 02, 2022

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:30 am.

  Members Present:  Bianca Plascencia, Finance Department
  Maria Heaney, Administration

  Staff Present:  Estrada, Teresa –Parks and Rec
  Ma, Ana – Police
  Pan, Michael - Legal

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of April 18, 2022, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Sunbelt Rentals, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  equipment needed for the city’s first annual Inglewood Stem Fest Event in the amount
  of $1,777.33. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Emergency Response Crime Scene Cleaning – Executive session to discuss
  recommend payment for providing services to the Inglewood Police Department in the
  amount of $750.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Closed Session - Confidential

  Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims
  Review Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California
  Government Code §54956.9(d)(1)); Marisol Villa vs City of Inglewood. LASC Case No
  19STCV03612. Motion carried unanimously

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:45 a.m.

Adjournment
